Agreement with the labels on 364 held-out persons, before and after fine-tuning, for eighteen models (mean of three seeds). kev-27b 86.3% to 97.4%; decider-35B-A3B 85.2% to 97.3%; kev-4b 88.2% to 97.1%; JEV-27B 91.5% to 96.9%; kev-9b 83.8% to 96.6%; Open-Jev-27B 64.3% to 96.5%; JEV-9B 49.2% to 96.1%; Open-Jev-9B 60.7% to 96.0%; JevK5-9B 81.0% to 95.8%; decider-4b 86.0% to 95.5%; GEV-26B 85.7% to 95.3%; openjev-NLI-4B 73.1% to 95.1%; decider-2b 73.9% to 94.4%; plumb-4b 84.9% to 94.4%; bekko-400m 83.5% to 93.0%; von 51.6% to 91.8%; Laya 46.7% to 91.6%; GLiNER2.5-Decide 39.6% to 91.3%.

g.text: Before any training, the eighteen models agree with the labels between 40% and 92% of the time.
Fine-tuned on the same 2,780 decisions, every one lands between 91% and 97%.
GLiNER2.5-Decide, the model behind our last run, finishes last. kev-4b reaches 97.1%.
The top six are within one point of each other: about three people out of 364.
AGREEMENT WITH THE LABELS · 364 HELD-OUT PERSONS · MEAN OF 3 SEEDS
